failure_taxonomy.unknown_task: Instruction did not map to a known task family.
failure_taxonomy.security_miss: Security task failed without an appropriate skill.
failure_taxonomy.security_partial: Partial skill bundle on security task.
failure_taxonomy.incomplete_medium: Medium task incomplete without planning cue.
failure_taxonomy.no_scaffold: Model needs prompt or skill scaffolding.
failure_taxonomy.plan_without_skill: Plan prompt alone insufficient for task slice.
failure_taxonomy.skill_without_plan: Skill alone insufficient for task slice.
failure_taxonomy.skill_conflict: Combined skills conflict for this model/task.
failure_taxonomy.brittle_baseline: Bare baseline prompt failed on a brittle model.
failure_taxonomy.brittle_medium: Medium task failed on brittle model.
failure_taxonomy.deliberate_wrong: Solved path skipped; wrong/empty artifact written.

note: Profiles are research fixtures for methodology delivery. Do not treat outcomes as evidence about hosted LLM products.
